messages:
marta: seeing a p99 jump in canary after runtime v2.4.0 swap. hyperpath cohort p95 110ms -> 420ms, p99 280ms -> 1.2s. repro traces attached. @devin @rick any ideas? :eyes:

devin: looking. grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/abc123. early signal points to increased stop-the-world GC and longer scheduler hold on a subset of hosts.

rick: did we change kernel selector or heap-affinity in 2.4.0? i recall a flag around NUMA/affinity.

laura: pulled logs from canary pod-7c9f: 
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:05Z] gc_pause_ms=128
[2026-03-17T09:12:05Z] kv_cache_hit=0.82
[2026-03-17T09:12:06Z] thread_pool_block=45ms
```
seeing small GC bursts that line up with tails.

ken: we rolled kernel-selector opt-in earlier. @deploy-bot which hosts got v2.4.0?

deploy-bot: deploy: runtime/v2.4.0 -> cohort hyperpath, 8 hosts scheduled at 09:10 UTC. no rollbacks yet.

marta: ok let's run a quick synthetic repro targeted at hyperpath cohort. ken, can you run stressproxy with seq lengths similar to customer traffic? drop the command here.

ken: running: 
```
stressproxy --cohort=hyperpath --seq=512,1024 --qps=50 --duration=5m
```

devin: also try toggling --kernel-selector=legacy to see delta.

rick: if toggle helps we can bisect between kernel-selector and heap-affinity. otherwise rollback.

laura: correlating metrics: hosts with affinity=true show higher allocator stall counters. allocator path + scheduler seems plausible.

marta: decision: perform canary rollback for hyperpath to v2.3.1 if synthetic repro matches p99. ken, schedule rollback and add temporary telemetry (tag requests with cohort+runtime_version).

ken: rollback queued. command: 
```
deployctl rollback --service=runtime --cohort=hyperpath --to-version=v2.3.1 --force
```

deploy-bot: rollback started at 09:28 UTC. 8 hosts targeted, rolling one-by-one.

devin: after first two hosts back to v2.3.1 p95 dropped from 420ms -> 130ms, p99 down to ~300ms. :thumbsup:

marta: good. next steps: bisect commit range between v2.3.1 and v2.4.0. devin, prepare kernel-selector toggle matrix and heap-affinity toggle. run a longer 1h synthetic on canary pool.

devin: on it. hypothesis: kernel-selector change + allocator tweak combine to expose long tail under mixed seq lengths. i'll run a narrow bisect matrix and paste results here.

rick: i'll open an issue with perf graphs, logs, repro commands, and notify support/CS about rollback + ETA to hold rollout.

laura: misc notes: add GC tuning to rollout checklist and a low-risk probe to detect allocator stalls early.

marta: thanks team. tag @oncall if recurrence after bisect. updating thread when bisect finishes.
